questions: You report three devices measured and four data sets, all shown (p. 8, p. 16). How many devices were fabricated or cooled, and how many QPC settings did you try on each before the ones shown?
Nothing appears to be set aside. Were any devices, settings or cooldowns dropped, and why?
Which magnetic fields across the 5/2 plateau, QPC transmissions and temperatures did you measure beyond the ones shown?
The second-best data sets are in Figs. S1 to S4, which answers the usual question. Why do Figs. 1b and 2b come from data set 4 and Fig. 3b from data set 3 (p. 17)?
Did you measure the excess noise at higher fridge temperatures? Braiding predicts a dependence through e*V_S/k_BT, and neutral-mode heating noise can scale differently.
What tunneling charge does each QPC show when it is biased directly at the transmission and low bias it has as the detector?
How was the electron temperature of 10 mK determined, and what uncertainty do the gain and temperature give on F_charge and F_neutral?

What would the theory in Fig. 3b give for an Abelian upstream neutral sector (M_n ≠ 0, for example the 331 order) and with braiding switched off? Showing those curves would show how far the data sit from each.
